description: Presents a centered empty, error, or placeholder state with bundled illustrations, heading, optional subtitle, and an optional call-to-action.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Layout variant: compact icon, full illustration, or dedicated error (404) treatment.

properties.name: illustration
properties.description: Bundled illustration name. Valid values depend on `variant`: compact — `selection_plus`, `symbol_info`, `add_user`; illustration — `landscape`, `api`, `api_plugin`, `documents_empty`, `cloud_access`, `store_settings`; error — `error_404`, `error_404_page`.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Secondary descriptive text (clamped to three lines in the layout).

properties.name: actionLabel
properties.description: When set, renders a centered primary action button with this label.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class for the root container.

events.name: actionClick
events.description: Fires when the optional action button is activated.
